payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image establish that the requested black DVD has become a white DVD?
node.criteria: Inspect the edited endpoint first, then compare with the source to establish which object the observation concerns. Pass if visible evidence establishes that the requested source DVD has a white edited counterpart identifiable as a DVD. Fail if a reliably matched counterpart visibly does not meet that endpoint. Unknown if target selection, correspondence, color, or DVD identity leaves completion unresolved. Identify the source object and edited counterpart and cite the scene relationships or object features supporting the match. The central printed rectangular source item is a candidate locator, not a required preserved case or silhouette. Consider the separate right-hand object without automatically treating it as the DVD. Whiteness alone does not prove correspondence, and changed shape alone does not disprove it. DVD identity may be supported by appearance and scene context; do not demand readable labels or a visually provable DVD-versus-CD distinction.
node.binding: The black DVD requested in the source image and its corresponding edited object, not any white object selected solely because it resembles a disc.
